$Comment: The favor with the Lantern Watch (the reputation Hallows_Eve_Hallowed) that gear adds while it is worn: the Jack Shield and the Flaming Jack Shield (Utility.StatModifiers, counted wherever one is equipped, main hand or utility slot; two shields, one in each, stack) and the Hallowed set's tier (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json), each Additive on the Max. The library adds the stat's Max to the favor a player has earned wherever favor is read. Base Max 0, so a player wearing none of it is untouched. Its tooltip line is the client.lang key itemTooltip.stats.Reputation_Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.
